components.css: .ds-cal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--color-paper, #fbfaf6); } .ds-cal-wd { padding-bottom: 4px; text-align: center; font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-3, #77726a); } .ds-cal li:not(.ds-cal-wd) { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e4dfd3); } .ds-cal-day { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 48px; padding: 4px 4px 0; font: 500 15px 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #151515); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cal-day:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-rule, #e4dfd3) 40%, transparent); } .ds-cal-day > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; } .ds-today { margin: -2px 0 0 -4px; border: 2px solid var(--color-marker, #1f5fd1); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-marker, #1f5fd1); } .ds-dot { position: absolute; bottom: 6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink, #151515); } .ds-ahead { color: var(--color-merah, #c4201a); } .ds-ahead .ds-dot { background: var(--color-merah, #c4201a); } .ds-future { color: var(--color-ink-3, #77726a); } .ds-future small { position: absolute; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; font: 10px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cal-day:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-marker, #1f5fd1); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The month is an Indonesian wall calendar hanging in the kitchen: warm paper, black ink, a ring of marker around today, and red print on the days that ran ahead of pace. Every screen is a page of that calendar or a ledger tucked behind it. There are no cards, no shadows, and no balance hero; structure comes from ink rules and narrow, calendar-scale numerals.

Density is ledger-like. Rows are separated by hairline rules, figures sit right-aligned in a narrow face, and explanations live behind a `details` disclosure rather than in extra panels. Color is a verdict, never decoration: the page is ink on paper until something is Aman, Mepet, or Lewat.

The system is phone-first (a home-screen web app) and opens into two columns at 1024px for the weekly laptop recap. Dark mode is not part of the system yet.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, black ink type, hairline warm-grey rules.
Archivo Narrow numerals at calendar scale over a system-ui body.
Status colors carry meaning only: red kebablasan, green aman, amber mepet.
Marker blue is reserved for today and focus.
Flat: depth is drawn with rules, never shadows.

rules.name: The Verdict-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Red, green, and amber appear only when they state a verdict about money. A heading, link, or button is never colored for emphasis.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Marker blue means "today" or "you are here" (focus, caret, selection). Never use it for links, data, or accents.

rules.name: The Narrow Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any rupiah figure or date that the eye hunts for is set in Archivo Narrow bold. Prose numbers inside a sentence stay in the body face, bolded.

rules.name: The Printed Page Rule
rules.body: If something needs separating, draw a rule; if it needs weight, fill it with ink. Never lift it with a shadow or wrap it in a card.

dos: Do set every hunted-for rupiah figure and date in Archivo Narrow bold, right-aligned in ledger rows.
Do separate content with 1px `rule` lines and frame the app shell with 2px ink rules.
Do keep red, green, and amber for Lewat, Aman, and Mepet verdicts only.
Do reserve marker blue for today's ring, the today tick, focus, caret, and selection.
Do put explanations behind a "Rincian" or "Lihat semua" disclosure instead of adding panels.
Do keep every control at least 44px and the page gutter at 16px.
donts: Don't add cards, panels with backgrounds, or box-shadows; the page is printed, not stacked.
Don't build a balance hero or a fintech card stack; the leaf and the calendar lead.
Don't use marker blue for links or data, or verdict colors for emphasis.
Don't set display numerals in the system face.
Don't introduce a second icon style; use the single 1.8px stroke family.
